entries.title: Good design is unobtrusive
entries.deck: Dieter Rams, the fifth of his ten principles. Pinned here as a working rule for everything on this site.
entries.quote: Products fulfilling a purpose are like tools. They are neither decorative objects nor works of art.
entries.note:
“Products fulfilling a purpose are like tools. They are neither decorative objects nor works of art. Their design should therefore be both neutral and restrained, to leave room for the user’s self-expression.”

Kept as a note rather than an essay because it needs no commentary. It’s the test for the journal’s pages, the diagrams and this side of the site: neutral and restrained, so the work and the reader have the room.
